title: Working on a Supernatural Stealth RPG in a 90's City
author: thetinytrex
selftext:
One of my favorite features of gaming is stealth. In Skyrim, I played a stealth mage and a sneaky pickpocket. I love Deus Ex exploration and doing pacificist takedowns. I played a pacifist run in Dishonored focusing on being undetected. And of course cardboard box sneaking in MGS games among many others. So I wanted to make a game about stealth, non-combat, and cool vibes. I've been working on this one for almost a month in my free time just for fun. Again, just a project for me but also anyone else who wants to try it for fun I was planning to put it on [itch.io](http://itch.io) for free.

The game is set in a fictional 90's Tokyo/Hong Kong mash-up city inspired by Yakuza and Disco Elysium. In a hit and run incident, your life is mistakenly saved by a nearby spirit, accidentally binding her to you and connecting your life between the living and the dead. In order to find a way to separate the ghost from you, you must strengthen your spiritual power and absorb the spiritual corruption throughout the city. Gain supernatural abilities like moving objects, possessing bodies, hiding in the shadows, etc. with a skill tree for each to lean into your playstyle. Go around the city and hang out, do missions, play at the arcade, eat at a cafe, or get drunk at the bar.  
  
The game is far from complete. I have 4 beginner maps, and 3 bigger missions so far but plan to add many more. I'm trying to fill up the city with more random stories and sub-stories to build out the supernatural phenomena that is all around the city.

I've been having a lot of fun with it and just wanted to share and see if people would be interested in it. Technical details: Opus 5.5 for everything + Godot
